limitations: This source PASS does not admit the fit. The V9 profile must complete successfully first; packet transport, fresh provider/quota and root controller admission, mounted input/source identities, and unchanged post-profile fit gates remain mandatory.
scope: Exact frozen fitV5 observer-only source review against fitV4 and root-frozen fit grader. No packet, provider, fit, export, or score action.

verification.durable_failure: Resource-gate failures persist resource_abort.json before raising. The top-level fit-pair receipt records every worker exception as aborted_no_retry with error type/reason, preserves partials, and declares retry_count=0.
verification.identity_and_fail_closed: The selected physical UUID is exact; CUDA property total must equal mem_get_info total; require 0 < CUDA free <= CUDA usable total <= NVML physical total. Missing/malformed inventory, query/domain failure, stale/inconsistent NVML free, wrong UUID, and cap/headroom failures abort. Raw process-query output/stderr and status remain bounded and preserved.
verification.observer_integration: FitV5 replaces the old exact-total comparison with the same exact UUID/CUDA/NVML domain helper as V9. Matched PID bytes are used when present; pid_not_reported or query_error uses max(NVML physical total - CUDA free, NVML physical total - NVML free), with the original 3,000,000,000-byte process cap. Batch boundaries refresh CUDA allocator/free counters using a recent validated NVML sample; full inventory refreshes at most three seconds apart and a one-second guard thread remains active.

recipe_invariance.fit_recipe_and_endpoint: Unchanged from reviewed fitV2: scratch raw-only GRU-128, seeds3/4, fixed epoch3, exact WMSE target semantics, same input/fold membership, equal pair versus E511 C1 recipe and metric.
recipe_invariance.plan_config_diff: Against the frozen fitV2 plan/config, changes are limited to observer/execution-optimization descriptors, new packet/plan identities and GPU-process observation-source text; no model, target, epoch, membership, objective, metric, or numeric resource limit changed.
recipe_invariance.resource_thresholds: Unchanged from fitV2; only the GPU-process measurement source/observer implementation and exact physical-memory identity binding changed. Worker/quota ceilings remain within the root conditional allocation.
